div.div:
IDENTITY AND CONSISTENCY
• PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; ? = nullable.
• Solid relationships: one parent to zero or many children.
• Import UQ*: (owner_id, card_id, file_sha256).
• Entry UQ*: (import_id, sequence), never merchant / amount.
• Enforce same-owner composite foreign keys throughout.
• active_import_id must belong to the same statement.
• Candidate files never silently replace the selected source.

div.div:
PDF RETENTION — CONFIGURABLE POLICY
• PDF bytes live on Import; ordinary queries exclude them.
• pdf_months = 24 is a configurable default, not a fixed limit.
• pdf_cleanup_enabled = false prevents policy cleanup.
• On cleanup: clear pdf_bytes and set pdf_deleted_at.
• Keep imports, fingerprints, and extracted entries.
• Missing statement dates require review, not invented expiry.
• Applying changes to existing PDFs: awaiting confirmation.

div.div:
EVIDENCE AND IMPLEMENTATION BOUNDARY
• amount uses exact Decimal-compatible NUMERIC, not float.
• Preserve nulls, raw source evidence, and parser issues.
• review_status: pending / reviewed / rejected.
• Totals use entries from the statement's active import.
• BINARY maps to PostgreSQL bytea through the SQL layer.
• Owner records alone do not provide authentication.
• Default-deny RLS is not per-user authentication.
• Versioned migration awaits PR review before deployment.
